title: Publish and explain brain-generated gap tasks through Susi workflow
goal: Expose gap-to-evidence-to-task lineage, assigned roadmap vector, priority rationale, dependencies and discovery brain provenance through existing tasks/roadmap/brain diagnostics with secret redaction. Persist and publish new tasks/vector proposals from an isolated claimed worktree with task trailers, merge current origin/main and the applicable repository validation/PR gates. Never delete/renumber others' tasks or vectors, steal claims, bypass checks or push directly to main. Distinguish draft, recorded locally, published, claimed and delivered states; discovery itself does not close implementation work. Hermetic repository tests cover concurrent records, invalid schema/dependency rejection and publication failure recovery. Implement nonzero tests named brain_gap_publication_* exercising production wiring.
